sloka: स तं प्रमुच्य त्रिदशारिमर्जुनः प्रपूज्य दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः ।अहिंसकं सख्यमुपेत्य साग्निकं प्रणम्य तं ब्रह्मसुतं गृहं ययौ ।। ७.३३.१८ ॥
transliteration: sa taṁ pramucya tridaśārimarjunaḥ prapūjya divyābharaṇasragambaraiḥ ।ahiṁsakaṁ sakhyamupetya sāgnikaṁ praṇamya taṁ brahmasutaṁ gṛhaṁ yayau ।। 7.33.18 ॥

translations.english: Having released Ravana, the enemy of the gods, Arjuna honored him with divine ornaments, garlands, and garments, then, having established a non-violent friendship witnessed by fire and bowed to Pulastya, the son of Brahma, he returned home.
translations.hindi: वह सजल मेघ की तरह नीली साड़ी पहिने थी। उसका सख चन्द्रमा की तरह था और सुन्दर भोंहें धनुष की तरह ना था
